# Banda Islands by working passenger ship

Reviewed 2026-10-09 for the edition `reports/2026-10-09-banda-islands`. Status: researching. Editorial view: strong pull. This is not group approval.

## The pull

About ten days in October or November: cross the Banda Sea from Ambon by ship or fast boat, stay six nights on Banda Neira, and take small boats to Banda Besar, Ai and Run. Mornings go to a reef that grew on a 1988 lava flow, afternoons to the history that made these islands the world's only source of nutmeg. Dive operators' high season, September to December, falls inside the friends' 2027 window [S8](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/dive-rates) [S9](https://www.themaulanahotel.com/diving).

The weakest assumption is the crossing. Every public Ambon–Banda option runs weekly or fortnightly [S14](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/getting-here) [S15](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/getting-here) [S17](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/getting-here).

## Journey and open time

Spine: fly to Jakarta or Bali, then to Ambon, then cross to Banda Neira for six nights with boat days, then return by boat or plane. Ambon is not an entry point for the electronic visa on arrival [S21](https://web.archive.org/web/20260728131041/https://www.imigrasi.go.id/wna/daftar-negara-voa-bvk-calling-visa/titik-masuk-bagi-pemegang-e-voa).

- **Anchors:** Neira on foot, the lava-flow reef [S7](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF01145887), and Banda Besar's nutmeg estates [S10](https://cilubintang.com/all-project-list/cultural-historical-field-trips/).
- **Open time:** at least one free day, plus a spare day before the return crossing.
- **Branches:** a night on Run; the November festival if the 2027 dates line up [S11](https://www.indonesia.travel/au-en/events/event-detail/banda-neira-festival-2026).
- **Excluded:** the Gunung Api climb. The trail has been closed since November 2024 [S12](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4485701/pos-pemantauan-gunung-api-banda-tutup-jalur-pendakian-sementara-waktu).

## Evidence and reality

- **Transport.** Pelni ships sail roughly twice a month [S14](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/getting-here). The fast boat runs weekly, about five hours [S15](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/getting-here) [S16](https://travel.detik.com/fototravel/d-8243789/menuju-banda-neira-kapal-cepat-jadi-transportasi-favorit-wisatawan). The plane has 12 seats and flies twice a week [S17](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/getting-here) [S18](https://www.jawapos.com/bisnis/2510200387/wisatawan-ke-banda-neira-melonjak-pelni-minta-dua-kapal-tambahan). Pelni shows only weeks ahead (unverified [S26](https://www.pelni.co.id/reservasi-tiket)), so no 2027 sailing can be confirmed now.
- **Entry.** US passports can use the visa on arrival: IDR 500,000 for 30 days, extendable to 60 [S19](https://web.archive.org/web/20260722074832/https://www.imigrasi.go.id/wna/daftar-visa-indonesia/B1) [S20](https://web.archive.org/web/20260926083946/https://www.imigrasi.go.id/wna/daftar-negara-voa-bvk-calling-visa).
- **Advisory.** Level 2 (Exercise Increased Caution), with no Maluku-specific warning [S22](https://travel.state.gov/_res/rss/TAsTWs.xml).
- **Volcano.** Gunung Api is at alert Level II [S13](https://magma.esdm.go.id/v1/gunung-api/tingkat-aktivitas).
- **Health.** Malaria prophylaxis is recommended for Maluku [S23](https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/destinations/traveler/none/indonesia). The district hospital lacked oxygen and specialists in 2024 [S24](https://ombudsman.go.id/perwakilan/news/r/pwkmedia--layanan-kesehatan-di-kepulauan-maluku-masih-terkendala-ombudsman-ri-desak-perbaikan). Whether Ambon's hyperbaric chamber is available is unverified [S27](https://web.archive.org/web/20260713033307/https://travel.state.gov/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/indonesia.html).
- **History.** 1621 conquest [S1](https://pala.westfriesmuseum.nl/1621-2/1621-article/?lang=en) [S2](https://pala.westfriesmuseum.nl/1621-2/1621-article/?lang=en); Run and Breda [S4](https://www.atlasofmutualheritage.nl/page/4236/run) [S5](https://archive.org/stream/europeantreaties02daveuoft/europeantreaties02daveuoft_djvu.txt) [S3](https://pala.westfriesmuseum.nl/1621-2/1621-article/?lang=en); UNESCO Tentative List since 2015 [S6](https://whc.unesco.org/fr/listesindicatives/6065). Tourism is rising, and Pelni has asked for more ships [S18](https://www.jawapos.com/bisnis/2510200387/wisatawan-ke-banda-neira-melonjak-pelni-minta-dua-kapal-tambahan).

## Spending and people

Money changes the trip in three places:
- a private boat for at least one crossing (quote required);
- a boat and guide for the island days (Cilu Bintang publishes custom trips without prices [S10](https://cilubintang.com/all-project-list/cultural-historical-field-trips/));
- a good room at The Maulana or Cilu Bintang (no published rates).

A liveaboard (17–27 October 2027, €5,450 per person [S25](https://konjocruisingindonesia.com/destinations/banda-sea-liveaboard-diving/)) removes the crossing risk but gives up the town.

Nobody has been contacted. Joining a nutmeg harvest is an UNVERIFIED proposal. Ask an estate; don't assume.

## Next decision

- Can the friends travel in October or November 2027?
- Should at least one crossing be a private boat, so the dates stop depending on Pelni's late timetable?
- Is diving central for anyone? That sets the season and the medical planning.

## Corrections

2026-10-09: The season now rests on operator evidence: high season September to December, closed June and July, August low [S8](https://www.dive-bluemotion.com/dive-rates) [S9](https://www.themaulanahotel.com/diving). It replaces the earlier estimate. The "Run for Manhattan" swap is a simplification [S3](https://pala.westfriesmuseum.nl/1621-2/1621-article/?lang=en) [S4](https://www.atlasofmutualheritage.nl/page/4236/run) [S5](https://archive.org/stream/europeantreaties02daveuoft/europeantreaties02daveuoft_djvu.txt). The inherited note's demand for a real passenger timetable is answered for 2026 only; 2027 timetables do not exist yet.

evidence.claim: In the VOC conquest of 1621, 44 orang kaya were executed outside Fort Nassau on 8 May 1621; a contemporary estimate put deaths from starvation in the hills at about 2,500; almost 800 captives were deported to Batavia.
evidence.support: "44 orang kaya ... were executed ... on the 8th of May 1621, outside the walls of Fort Nassau"; "perhaps 2,500 Bandanese died of starvation"; "almost 800 ... had been deported".
evidence.scope: Museum narrative citing VOC records. Gives no pre-conquest population total.

evidence.claim: Not all Bandanese were killed in 1621; some escaped and later tried to retake their homes.
evidence.support: "Not all Bandanese were killed. From the surrounding region, those who managed to escape attempted to recapture their homes."
evidence.scope: Counters single-number death tolls; survivors' later communities (e.g. Kei) are not detailed here.

evidence.claim: The Westfries Museum notes that Giles Milton's popular book exaggerates the idea that Run was exchanged for Manhattan.
evidence.support: Milton "slightly exaggerates several things, such as the notion that the island of Run was eventually exchanged for Manhattan, for the sake of the story."

evidence.claim: Run became English in 1616, was taken by the VOC in 1621, was transferred and retaken in 1665, and at the Peace of Breda in 1667 was ceded to the Dutch with Surinam in exchange for, among others, New Amsterdam.
evidence.publisher: Atlas of Mutual Heritage (Nationaal Archief, RCE, Rijksmuseum, KB)
evidence.support: "In the Peace of Breda in 1667 Run, along with Surinam, was ceded to the Dutch, in exchange for, among others, New Amsterdam."

evidence.claim: In the 1667 negotiations the Dutch raid on the Medway in late June "caused the English to yield in the matter of Pulo Run".
evidence.publisher: Carnegie Institution of Washington (F. G. Davenport, ed., European Treaties, vol. 2)
evidence.support: Editor's introduction to the Treaty of Breda: "The successful execution of this plan in the latter part of June caused the English to yield in the matter of Pulo Run."
evidence.scope: 1929 scholarly edition, read as OCR text. Supports 'a negotiated outcome', not a one-for-one swap.

evidence.claim: "The Historic and Marine Landscape of the Banda Islands" has been on Indonesia's UNESCO Tentative List since 30 January 2015 as a mixed site, citing kora-kora races, cakalele and coral regrowth after 1988.
evidence.support: Submission 30/01/2015, category mixed, criteria (iv)(vi)(x); "in a few years the coral rapidly grew back".

evidence.claim: Five years after the 1988 Gunung Api eruption, the sheltered lava flow carried 124 coral species and about 62% coral cover, more than an adjacent reef the lava missed.
evidence.support: Abstract: "Five years after the eruption, the sheltered lava flow supported a diverse coral community (124 species) with high coral cover (61.6% ± 7.5)".
evidence.scope: 1990s survey; present reef condition is a separate question. Journal dates the issue 1996/09.
evidence.recheck_before: None for history; ask dive operators about current state.

evidence.claim: Dive Bluemotion's seasons are high September-December, mid March-April, low January, February, May and August, and closed June-July; a one-tank dive costs IDR 750,000 in high season and a Run trip adds IDR 1,000,000 shared.
evidence.support: "High season: Sep - Dec" | "Mid season: Mar, Apr" | "Low season: Jan, Feb, May, Aug" | "Closed: Jun, Jul"; "1-tank trip: 750,000"; rates "valid until 31st Dec 2026".
evidence.scope: Operator prices for 2026; 2027 rates not published.

evidence.claim: The Maulana's dive centre, Banda Ocean Divers, names September-December as the best diving season and charges IDR 750,000 for one dive in high season.
evidence.support: "The best season for diving runs from September to December"; "1 Dive: IDR 750,000".
evidence.scope: Operator claim and price; the page shows no room rates.

evidence.claim: Cilu Bintang Estate publishes custom cultural trips, including picnicking on a private nutmeg plantation, fort walks and watching a cakalele dance, with Bandanese guides; no prices are shown.
evidence.support: "picnicking on a private nutmeg plantation"; "observing an authentic cakalele dance"; "multilingual bandanese" guides.
evidence.scope: Published offering only. Availability, price and any hands-on harvesting are not established.

evidence.claim: The Banda Neira Festival 2026 runs 12-14 November 2026, with a Belang parade, cakalele, a 1,000-dancer nutmeg harvest ceremony, a Gunung Api Banda trekking experience and a nutmeg trail run.
evidence.support: Page data: startDate 2026-11-12, endDate 2026-11-14; activity list as quoted. Site TLS certificate had expired; read via direct download.
evidence.scope: 2026 edition. 2027 dates not announced. The listed trek conflicts with the summit-trail closure (S12).

evidence.claim: The Banda Api climbing route has been closed since 18 November 2024 at alert Level II, with a 1 km exclusion around the crater; no reopening criteria were given.
evidence.support: "Saat ini kita telah menutup jalur pendakian Gunung Api Banda terhitung sejak 18 November 2024" (monitoring post coordinator).
evidence.scope: No 2026 reopening found. A 2025 blog describes climbers reaching the summit anyway (not relied on).

evidence.claim: Indonesia's volcano monitoring service lists Banda Api at Level II (Waspada).
evidence.publisher: PVMBG / MAGMA Indonesia (Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources)
evidence.support: Activity-level page read 2026-10-09: "Banda Api - Maluku" listed under "Level II (Waspada)".
evidence.recheck_before: Before travel and before any trip near the crater.

evidence.claim: Four Pelni ships serve Ambon-Banda roughly twice a month: Labobar in about 8 hours, and Pangrango, Sangiang and Sabuk Nusantara 106 in about 14-16 hours; cabins are often bought from the crew for about IDR 800,000-1,000,000.
evidence.support: Lists LABOBAR "8h trip", PANGRANGO/SANGIANG/SABUK NUSANTARA 106 "14-16h trip", cabins "IDR 800,000-1,000,000 directly to the crew".
evidence.scope: Undated operator guide; Pelni changes routes and times.
evidence.recheck_before: Against Pelni's own schedule once published (S26).

evidence.claim: The Cantika fast boat runs Tulehu (Ambon)-Banda once a week, about 5 hours: Tulehu Thursdays 09:00, Banda Sundays 07:00; VIP IDR 800,000, Premium with lunch IDR 1,050,000.
evidence.support: "Tulehu-Banda: Thursdays, 9:00 am"; "Banda-Tulehu: Sundays, 7:00 am"; "VIP IDR 800,000"; "Premium (includes lunch) IDR 1,050,000".
evidence.scope: Undated. The boat is weather- and season-dependent (S35).

evidence.claim: Express Cantika 88 sails to Banda Neira once a week and takes about five hours.
evidence.support: "berlayar setiap sepekan sekali"; "ditempuh selama lima jam".

evidence.claim: Smart Air flies Ambon-Banda on Mondays at 07:00 and back on Tuesdays at 07:00, for about IDR 450,000-500,000, with a 10 kg baggage limit.
evidence.support: "Ambon-Banda: Mondays, 07:00"; "Banda-Ambon: Tuesdays, 07:00"; "10Kg max".
evidence.scope: Undated; other sources give different days (S36). 12-seat aircraft (S18).

evidence.claim: Pelni reported tourists to Banda Neira up 15% and 49,529 passengers landed in 2024; four Pelni ships serve the route, the Ambon branch wants two more, and the only air link is a 12-seat plane.
evidence.support: "wisatawan naik 15 persen"; "Saya butuh dua kapal penumpang tambahan"; 2024 total 49,529.

evidence.claim: Indonesia's visa on arrival (B1) allows 30 days from arrival, extendable once to 60 days in total, for IDR 500,000; the electronic version (e-VoA) is issued via evisa.imigrasi.go.id or indonesiavoa.vfsevisa.id.
evidence.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration (archived capture of 2026-07-22)
evidence.support: "Biaya visa B1 Rp 500.000 (untuk 30 hari)"; "maksimal 30 hari"; extension "satu kali hingga ... maksimal 60 hari".
evidence.scope: Read as a Wayback capture; the live site blocks automated fetches. A fee rise was proposed in Aug 2026 (S33).

evidence.claim: The United States ("Amerika Serikat") is on Indonesia's visa-on-arrival country list.
evidence.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration (archived capture of 2026-09-26)
evidence.support: Country list includes "Amerika Serikat".

evidence.claim: The e-VoA entry-point list includes Jakarta (Soekarno-Hatta), Bali (Ngurah Rai) and Makassar (Sultan Hasanuddin) but not Ambon's Pattimura airport.
evidence.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration (archived capture of 2026-07-28)
evidence.support: Text of the list names Soekarno-Hatta, Ngurah Rai and Sultan Hasanuddin; Pattimura and Ambon do not appear.
evidence.scope: e-VoA list only; plan to enter elsewhere and fly on to Ambon.

evidence.claim: The US State Department rates Indonesia Level 2 (Exercise Increased Caution) for natural disasters, unrest and terrorism, issued 7 July 2026; the summary names no Maluku-specific risk.
evidence.support: Feed item "Indonesia - Level 2: Exercise Increased Caution", pubDate 7 Jul 2026.
evidence.scope: Read from the official RSS feed; full advisory page not fetched.

evidence.claim: CDC lists all of Maluku province as a malaria transmission area and recommends chemoprophylaxis (atovaquone-proguanil, doxycycline, mefloquine or tafenoquine).
evidence.support: "All areas of eastern Indonesia (the provinces of Maluku, North Maluku, East Nusa Tenggara, Papua, and West Papua)". Page last reviewed 25 Aug 2026.

evidence.claim: In April 2024 a doctor at RSUD Banda Neira, the district hospital, reported frequent oxygen shortages and no paediatric or internal-medicine specialist.
evidence.support: "tabung oksigen murni yang sering habis, kekurangan dokter spesialis ... tidak ada tenaga spesialis anak dan penyakit dalam".

evidence.claim: Konjo Cruising lists a Wild Banda Sea Expedition on 17-27 October 2027 (10 nights) at EUR 5,450 per person, with 6 seats available.
evidence.support: "17-27th October 2027"; "5450€/Pers"; "6 SEATS AVAILABLE".
evidence.scope: Published shared departure, not a booking; private-charter terms not shown.

evidence.claim: Pelni's booking system shows sailings only weeks ahead (searches beyond late November 2026 returned none); in Oct-Nov 2026 Labobar left Ambon about 01:00 on alternate Tuesdays, reaching Banda about 09:00.
evidence.support: Research agent's form queries on 2026-10-09/10; not repeated by the editor.
evidence.recheck_before: When Pelni opens bookings for the travel dates.

evidence.claim: The State Department's Indonesia page mentions hyperbaric chambers in Bali, Manado and Ambon.
evidence.support: Research agent quoted "Hyperbaric chambers... Bali, Manado, and Ambon"; not reopened by the editor. A 2023 German embassy list omits Ambon.
evidence.scope: Whether a chamber in Ambon is working in 2027 is unknown.

evidence.claim: Master Liveaboards' October 2027 Banda Sea trips from Ambon (7-12 nights, USD 4,228-7,140) are listed as sold out.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading on 2026-10-10 (UTC); not reopened by the editor.

evidence.claim: Whole-boat charters in the Spice Islands were advertised at about USD 18,700-26,000 per night in 2026.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading (Kudanil Explorer USD 26,000/night + VAT; Silolona from USD 18,700/night); not reopened by the editor.

evidence.claim: Mohammad Hatta and Sutan Sjahrir lived in exile on Banda Neira from 1936 until they were flown out in 1942; Hatta's house and the small school he ran are visited today.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading; sources differ on exact arrival and departure dates.

evidence.claim: The Van den Broeke family still works a nutmeg perk on Banda Besar (about 12.5 ha), harvests three or four times a year, and sells nutmeg oil to visiting tourists.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading; no visit programme is published.
evidence.recheck_before: Ask the estate before promising a visit.

evidence.claim: A second Tentative List entry, the spice-trade-route nomination of 15 April 2025, includes Banda and calls Perk Waling the only intact perk.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading via an extraction tool; not reopened by the editor.

evidence.claim: A higher visa-on-arrival fee (IDR 750,000 e-VoA, IDR 1,000,000 on arrival) was proposed in August 2026 but was reported as not yet in force.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading of secondary reports; not reopened by the editor.

evidence.claim: In October 2025 a Pelni sailing from Banda to Ambon was overfull, with passengers sleeping on corridor mats, and a patient was carried aboard by ambulance for referral to Ambon; missing a sailing can mean waiting days.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading; not reopened by the editor.

evidence.claim: In 2025 the fast boat stopped sailing to Banda after 1 May and resumed on 28 August, once the Banda Sea was safe, hoping to run until early December.
evidence.publisher: Tulehu port account on TikTok (official status unverified)
evidence.support: Research agent read the caption via oEmbed; not reopened by the editor.

evidence.claim: Smart Aviation's Ambon-Banda tickets could not be bought from Jakarta or Surabaya in May 2026, only at the Ambon airport counter, and flights were full for a week.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading of a first-person column; not reopened by the editor.

evidence.claim: Estimates put Banda's population before 1621 at roughly 13,000-15,000, with perhaps 1,000 survivors remaining in the islands, enslaved; scholars differ on how many died, fled or were deported.
evidence.support: Research agent's reading; the underlying estimates (Loth, Winn, Lape, Straver) were not read.
evidence.recheck_before: Read the primary studies before quoting a number.

evidence.claim: KM Labobar (Pelni) is IMO 9281542, MMSI 525005052, call sign YHKN, Indonesian flag, broadcasting AIS with destination BANDA (last update shown 19 Oct 2026 23:20 UTC).
evidence.support: Editor read: "KM LABOBAR", IMO "9281542", MMSI "525005052", call sign "YHKN", flag "ID", destination "BANDA", AIS last update "19-Oct-2026 23:20 (UTC+00:00)".
evidence.scope: Third-party AIS tracker page; registry fields (name, IMO, MMSI, call sign, flag). MMSI can change with reflagging; the AIS update time shows the ship was broadcasting.
evidence.recheck_before: Before relying on the live chart for this ship
